lines.C01: [irritated, sharp] Marcel — down! {{pause=0.3}} [haughty, regal] Bow. Lower. Good. {{pause=0.3}} [smug, drawling] Welcome to Versailles. [delighted, self-admiring] Yes, I am that handsome. {{pause=0.4}} [sneering, amused] Try not to faint.
lines.C02: [conspiratorial, proud] A hundred people watch me wake up. {{pause=0.2}} The French call it the lever. {{pause=0.4}} [smug, with a soft laugh] I call it a premiere.
lines.C03: [dry, bored] The doctor is here. The surgeon is here. {{pause=0.3}} [mock-puzzled] Nobody came for them. {{pause=0.4}} [commanding, then breathy with delight] Look at me. {{pause=0.5}} [swooning] Magnificent.
lines.C04: [brisk] Now. The wig. {{pause=0.3}} [mock-tragic, a small sigh] At seventeen my hair started leaving. {{pause=0.3}} [wounded pride] I took it personally. {{pause=0.3}} [dry, resolute] So I took a wig.
lines.C05: [smug] It makes me taller. {{pause=0.2}} The Louvre says so. {{pause=0.3}} [lofty] I did not ask. {{pause=0.5}} [soft sigh of delight] What a face, though. {{pause=0.3}} [admiring] Honestly.
lines.C06: [theatrical, savouring] White. {{pause=0.3}} Grey. {{pause=0.3}} Powdered. {{pause=0.4}} [prophetic, grandly] Everyone will wear it one day. {{pause=0.4}} [mock-modest, chuckles] I am simply early.
lines.C07: [regal, bored] Bow. Lower. Good. {{pause=0.4}} [delighted, preening] Yes, white suits me. {{pause=0.3}} [arrogant] Everything suits me.
lines.C08: [contemptuous] A hundred people, and only one worth looking at. {{pause=0.5}} [tender, adoring] Me. {{pause=0.3}} [snorts a laugh] Obviously.
lines.C09: [sharp, scandalised] Lower... {{pause=0.3}} [outraged whisper] that is a hat. {{pause=0.3}} [recovering haughtiness] Eyes on me, not the hat.
lines.C10: [flirtatious, teasing] Red heels. A privilege of nobles. {{pause=0.3}} [smug] Only the ones I like. {{pause=0.4}} [admiring sigh] Look at that ankle.
lines.C12: [grand, showman] Venice sold mirrors. France made three hundred and fifty-seven. {{pause=0.3}} [gleeful] I am in all of them. {{pause=0.3}} [laughs softly] Lucky mirrors.
lines.C13: [snapping, irritated] Do not stand behind me. {{pause=0.2}} You ruin the reflection. {{pause=0.5}} [swooning] Ah... {{pause=0.2}} what a profile.
lines.C14: [mock-generous] Tonight, I dine in public. You may watch. {{pause=0.3}} [firm] Do not stare. {{pause=0.4}} [sly, conspiratorial] Well... a little. {{pause=0.5}} [imperious, grand] Subscribe to my stunning channel.
lines.C15: [imperious, commanding] Like it. {{pause=0.2}} Ring the bell. {{pause=0.4}} [laughs, a rich delighted villainous laugh] {{pause=0.4}} [dismissive, bored] Anyway... do what you like. {{pause=0.3}} [gleeful, hungry] I am off to the table to feast!
